Package Models.Orders

Class AdvanceOrder

  • java.lang.Object
    • Models.Orders.AdvanceOrder
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Order
    public class AdvanceOrder
extends java.lang.Object
implements Order
    This class represents an Advance Order in the game. An Advance Order allows a player to move armies from one country to another.

    • Method Detail

      • execute

        public void execute​(WarMap warMap)
        Executes the Advance Order. Moves the specified number of armies from the source country to the target country. If the target territory belongs to another player, an attack happens between the two territories.
        Specified by:
        execute in interface Order
        Parameters:
        warMap - The warmap of the gameengine that the order takes place
